description: This Java class defines the data structure for loan term variations within the Fineract project, including properties, constructors, and comparison logic.

classes.name: LoanTermVariationsData
classes.description: Represents variations in loan terms, including applicable dates, values, and type, with comparison and applicability methods.

methods.name: getTermVariationType
methods.description: Returns the type of variation as a LoanTermVariationType enum.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the variation is applicable within a date range.

methods.name: occursOnDayFromAndUpTo
methods.description: Determines if a target date occurs within a specified date range.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the variation is applicable from a specific date.

methods.name: occursBefore
methods.description: Checks if a date occurs before a target date.

methods.name: isSpecificToInstallment
methods.description: Returns whether the variation is specific to an installment.

methods.name: isProcessed
methods.description: Returns whether the variation has been processed.

methods.name: setProcessed
methods.description: Sets the processed status of the variation.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this variation to another based on applicable date and variation type.

methods.name: setApplicableFromDate
methods.description: Sets the date from which the variation is applicable.
